entry.author: Inland Revenue NZ
entry.summary:
Kia ora! Welcome to part 3 of 5 of our GST workshop. In part 3, we'll discuss record keeping and the requirements for your records, such as invoices. GST is a tax added to the price of most goods and services, including imports. Supplies are goods or services you provide while carrying on your business. For GST purposes, supplies are dealt with differently depending on the type of supply. Find out more about GST and why you might need to register: https://www.ird.govt.nz/gst

----------------------------------------------------------------

If you have enjoyed this video, watch our other parts:

GST Workshop part 1 (Registering): https://youtu.be/dQod_CI5Shc 
GST Workshop part 2 (Supplies): https://youtu.be/9vHVUNWoO04
GST Workshop part 4 (Adjustments): https://youtu.be/2pjd6L3fH1A 
GST Workshop part 5 (Filing and Ceasing GST): https://youtu.be/51TZd4UIHK0 

----------------------------------------------------------------
